text.en: Believing the universe's hydrogen and helium were mostly produced later, inside stars, through ordinary stellar nucleosynthesis — the vast majority of the universe's helium (and essentially all its deuterium) was produced within the first few minutes after the Big Bang, well before any star existed; stars have only converted a small additional fraction of hydrogen into helium since then.
text.et: Arvamus, et universumi vesinik ja heelium toodeti enamasti hiljem, tähtede sees, tavalise tähesisese nukleosünteesi kaudu — valdav enamus universumi heeliumist (ja sisuliselt kogu selle deuteerium) toodeti esimese paari minuti jooksul pärast Suurt Pauku, palju enne, kui ükski täht eksisteeris; tähed on sellest ajast peale muutnud vesinikust heeliumiks ainult väikese lisaosa.
